name: SDF flight
doc: A raymarched fly-through of an endless lattice of tumbling rounded boxes, along a winding tube carved through it. Each box listens to one spectrum band: it swells, rounds toward a sphere and glows with it; the camera surges on every beat (closed-form in time and beat count, so hosts agree) and the lens widens with the bass. Rendered at reduced resolution and upscaled.

palette.doc: boxes pick a stop per cell; stop 0 tints the fog, the last stop the rims

speed.doc: base flight speed, units per second (scales the closed-form distance: keep it fixed, binding it to a signal makes the camera jump)

surge.doc: extra speed at the start of each beat

morph.doc: how much band energy swells and rounds the boxes

tunnel.doc: radius of the free tube around the flight path

scale.doc: render resolution as a share of the output
